name: Shell command guard
summary: Block high-confidence destructive shell commands before Claude Code executes them.
description: A bounded Claude Code PreToolUse hook that rejects catastrophic filesystem, disk, Git remote, GitHub, credential-store, and internet-to-shell command patterns without executing or rewriting input.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks high-confidence destructive shell commands before Claude Code executes them; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not execute, rewrite, sanitize, or automatically approve a submitted command.
It does not claim to be a sandbox or a complete shell parser.
It does not provide a hidden bypass for blocked destructive actions.

entrypoints.purpose: Evaluate structured runtime input and deterministically allow or block the guarded operation.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block high-confidence destructive shell commands before Claude Code executes them without deferred work.
